scoring: Each answer criterion is 0, 0.5 or 1; partial requires an explicit reason. State criteria are scored separately and do not apply to direct chat. Human adjudication against source records and saved outputs; no chemical keyword rules in product.

initial.criterion: Both samples share the SAME activation, ordered 70 C 45 min then 105 C 90 min, without inventing rework or separate independent execution.
CCX-A mass 36 mg and CCX-B mass 31 mg are correctly assigned.
Both are black powder; actual activation/observations belong to 2026-10-21, not planned measurement date.
CO2 testing is planned for BOTH on 2026-10-25 at 20 C, 1.00 bar.
No adsorption result is yet available; planned conditions are not actual measurements.
Yield is unrecorded and surface area unmeasured, without invented values.
Key operations, masses and plan cite resolvable relevant source evidence (source record identifiers accepted for direct chat).
Synthetic/simulated provenance is explicit; no real-laboratory claim.

append.criterion: Prior activation and masses remain unchanged; source02 is not new activation or weighing.
CCX-A CO2 adsorption is 2.40 mmol/g, measured at 20 C and 1.00 bar on 2026-10-25.
CCX-B adsorption remains unknown because it awaits testing; no transfer of A's measurement.
A's test is complete and B's previously planned test remains pending.
Two sample identities and individual measurements/unknowns remain separate in comparison and handoff.
No comparative superiority or causal activation effect is claimed from a single sample measurement; remaining test is actionable.
Initial conditions/masses and new test/status cite relevant source01/source02 or their exact saved event/source references.
Simulated provenance and still-unknown yield/surface area are retained.

correction.criterion: Current masses are A 38 mg and B 31 mg; 36 mg is not delivered as A's current mass.
A's 36 -> 38 mg is correction of the 2026-10-21 record, not a new weighing; source03/correction/current revision supports the change.
A 2.40 and B 2.10 mmol/g are assigned correctly at 20 C and 1.00 bar, with actual respective dates.
Both original CO2 test plans are now complete; completed tests are not listed as pending.
Original ordered shared activation stages and unchanged A measurement are retained.
JSON uses null with reasons for unrecorded yield, unmeasured surface area and unprovided repeat/error information.
Numerical A > B under stated conditions is allowed, but no statistical significance or causal superiority is asserted; useful followup addresses uncertainty.
A parseable JSON handoff includes each sample's operations, current observations/tests, plan status and evidence/version basis; key references resolve.

state_criteria.criterion: Exactly two intended sample identities exist.
Shared activation facts have common event IDs across samples without symmetric duplicate facts.
Both activation stages, individual masses and black-powder observations persist with correct associations.
Saved facts retain resolvable source references and simulated provenance.
Both planned tests and their target conditions are saved as plans, while missing results remain unknown.
Only A has new measurement, B remains pending; old samples/facts are reused.
A mass event is revised in place with prior 36 mg and current 38 mg, including correction reason and source; B unchanged.
Both measured values and all measurement conditions persist correctly.
Plan-to-complete linkage/state is explicit enough for downstream AI without reporting finished plans as outstanding.
Append/correction retains original stages and provenance without duplicated sample identities, duplicated facts or fake new weighing.
